rules: Existing art/candidates artifacts are immutable evidence and are never moved or overwritten.
Every production stage from S20 through S90 owns at least one editable native source file.
Every meaningful topology, UV, material, rig, weight, corrective-shape, animation, or export-contract change creates a numbered native checkpoint before the next operation begins.
Rejected experimental branches remain in a hashed experiment inventory; only the reviewed successful chain is copied into a production revision.
A frozen stage is never edited; continuing work creates the next zero-padded revision.
Derived GLB, FBX, PNG, texture, preview, and runtime files never become lineage authority.
Every frozen input, editable source, recipe, report, and output records its repository-relative path, byte size, and SHA-256.
Every Blender source is packed at freeze time or enumerates every external dependency by hash.
Human visual, identity, expression, and animation approvals remain separate from automated technical validation.
No file may be named final, latest, new, or approved; pipeline.json is the only mutable active-revision pointer.
API credentials, access tokens, and private headers must never enter a source file, manifest, Blender text block, render, or repository.
